title: Deterministic Instruction Step
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register program, let an oracle assign a Boolean answer to each decider and bit string, and fix an input word, a program state $l$, and a deterministic instruction $i$. If $A$ assigns the deterministic instruction $i$ to $l$, then for any choice bit $b$, register valuation, and optional result, one step of the nondeterministic program from state $l$ agrees with one step of the deterministic program that assigns instruction $i$ to every state.
hypotheses_covered: arbitrary register valuation and optional result
